svg.title: Goryeo: court, fortress and surviving woodblocks
svg.desc: The Korean peninsula with Kuju near modern Kusong, Kaesong, Ganghwa Island and Haeinsa. Yalu, Tumen, Han and Nakdong rivers provide modern reference geography. The map does not show a reconstructed Goryeo frontier.
